issues.message: 8 fence/pane/wall block(s) have no north/east/south/west set although a neighbour would connect, so they show as lone posts: (2, 5, 1), (3, 5, 1), (1, 5, 2) and 5 more.

notes.artefacts: platform fences show as lone posts

visual.summary: A clean four-legged tower with a good overhanging roof, but bare: lone fence posts on the platform and nothing at the base.
problems: Give the platform a proper railing: the fences don't connect, so they show as lone posts
Mix the materials: a cobblestone footing under the four legs, stripped logs or a different wood for the platform floor, a darker roof edge
Add watchtower detail: a bell or a lantern on a chain under the roof, a banner, a ladder-like stair landing, a torch on each side
Add life at the base: a hay bale, barrels, a bush or flowers by the legs
